name: esenv
description: Evidence-oriented ExtendScript environment and capability detection for ES-family consumers

scripts.estc:check: npm run build:jsx && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESENV.jsx --no-target
scripts.estc:live: npm run build:jsx && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESENV.jsx --no-target --live
scripts.verify:engine: npm run estc:live && npm run live-verify
scripts.ci:local: npm run ci:static && npm run verify:engine
